name: sitefire
description: Sitefire AI search visibility analytics: see how AI answer engines mention and cite your brand, manage the questions and topics Sitefire monitors, and act on content briefings from your agent.

interface.longDescription:
Sitefire is an AI search visibility platform for marketing, SEO, and content teams. It measures how often AI answer engines mention and cite your brand for the questions your customers ask.

Connect your Sitefire account to ask about your visibility score, trends, citation rate, and competitor ranking; to see which topics you win or lose and which of your pages AI answers cite; and to manage the questions and topics that Sitefire monitors.

Sitefire also turns gaps into actions. Each action gets a briefing from Sitefire's analysis agents, with a content outline, page improvements, outreach drafts, or forum posts. You can review briefings, start article generation, and inspect or tune the agents that do the work.

You see only the workspace data that your Sitefire account can access. Viewers can read; changing data needs the workspace admin role.
capabilities: Analyze AI visibility and competitor ranking
Find topics and pages that AI models cite
Research and manage monitored prompts and topics
Review action briefings and start article generation
Read agent runs and publish agent configuration changes
defaultPrompt: How visible is our brand in AI answers this month?
Which topics are we losing to competitors in AI answers?
Which content actions are ready to work on?

positive.prompt: How visible is our brand in AI answers over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the visibility score, its trend, the citation rate, and the competitor ranking for the test workspace, using only values returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: Which topics are we losing to competitors in AI answers?
positive.expected_behavior: List the topics with a losing position and name the competitors that appear instead, from the tool result.

positive.prompt: Which content actions are ready to work on?
positive.expected_behavior: Group the workspace's actions by type and status, and summarize the briefing of each action whose briefing is complete. No action is created or changed.

positive.prompt: Show the questions we monitor, grouped by topic.
positive.expected_behavior: List the monitored topics with their questions and status. No prompt or topic is changed.

positive.description: Find pages that AI models cite
positive.prompt: Which of our pages get cited most by AI models?
positive.expected_behavior: List the workspace's own pages ranked by AI citations for the selected period, from the tool result.

negative.prompt: Book a flight from Munich to Berlin for tomorrow.

negative.description: General knowledge question without a Sitefire context
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
